# Putting people first

##### Our People + Talent experts can help you build the best team for your business

![](https://octopusventures.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/16/2022/10/09b_We-Provide-More.jpg)

## We provide more than just money

Businesses begin with people, and getting it right from the start is vital. Our Portfolio People + Talent team has scaled the likes of DeepMind, Checkout.com, Harry’s and other high-growth startups. Each of our six investment areas has a People + Talent partner on board. We aim to be an extension of your team, advising on everything from compensation to organisational structure, design to employee well-being, and leadership to communication. Working together, we can bring your vision to life.

## Setting you up for success

We’ll work with you to set up the best hiring practices, with a clear and consistent mission your future employees can get behind. If you join us at the seed or series A investment stage, we’ll assign you a dedicated People + Talent partner for the first 12 months. Together, we’ll help plan and implement your strategy for recruitment, retention, leadership and culture. All of our founders, including those joining at pre-seed stage, have access to our gold mine of resources and guides for building a successful team.

![](https://octopusventures.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/16/2022/10/09c_Setting-You-Up.jpg)

## Leadership Programme

Twice a year, over six weeks, we match the founders and senior leaders from the companies we support with some of the best execs and operators in our network.

Across a series of one-hour meetings, seasoned professionals share their knowledge and experience with the leadership of tomorrow.
